# Tessik Health

Tessik Health develops ChairFlow, a scheduling and billing platform tailored for dental practices. ChairFlow intelligently optimizes chair utilization by dynamically scheduling patient appointments to minimize wait times and maximize provider efficiency. The product also integrates insurance claims processing and automated recall campaign management, streamlining administrative workflows.

Customers mainly include mid-sized dental practices and group clinics aiming to improve operational performance and patient satisfaction. Early pilot programs across 12 clinics showed an average 18% increase in chair utilization and a 25% reduction in billing errors.

Founded in 2023, Tessik Health recently closed a $3.5 million seed round led by Crestwood Ventures, targeting expanded product development and market entry. The founding team combines healthcare IT expertise with dental practice management experience.

Key competitors include OrthoSched, DentAligner, and SmileSync, which offer partial scheduling or billing features. Open risks involve integration challenges with diverse practice management systems and resistance from traditional dental offices hesitant to adopt new workflows.
